title: Ergast Race Result Weekly Gap to Leader Trend
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ergast:result gap_to_leader_seconds=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(gap_to_leader_seconds) as avg_duration, max(gap_to_leader_seconds) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst gap to leader for Ergast race result events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture gap_to_leader_seconds on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average gap to leader with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether Ergast race result tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
